plugins.name: peanut-gallery
plugins.description: A private back channel where any agent leaves Jeff a short note, reminder, suggestion, or criticism. Only Jeff reads them, through /gallery.

plugins.name: delegate-ledger
plugins.description: A ledger of every subagent and background shell, kept across restarts. Flags unread results and offers to relaunch work a dead session left running.

plugins.name: taste-fork
plugins.description: A critic with Jeff's taste reads each deliverable once after it is written and hands its findings back to the agent to fix.

plugins.name: hillclimb-loop
plugins.description: Climbs a rubric round after round, keeping only measured gains, until a stop rule fires.
